page.title: Illustrated Parts Catalog
page.subtitle: Choose the vehicle by chassis, browse its illustrated assemblies, then select a numbered callout to see the matching parts.

figure.title: OEM exploded view
figure.estimated: Callout positions are estimated from the PDF text and are not yet verified by a reviewer.
figure.estimatedMatched: Matched to this parts table by index numbers. Positions are estimated from the PDF text and are not yet verified by a reviewer.
figure.noCallouts: This page has no readable callout numbers. Choose the index from the parts table.
figure.error: This illustration page could not be displayed.
figure.unlinked: No figure page is linked to this assembly. Its parts are listed on the right.

parts.title: Parts for this assembly
parts.addSelected: Add selected part to work order

choose.title: Choose an assembly
choose.body: The drawing and its linked parts appear here together. No separate PDF window opens.

selected.sourceLine: List PDF p. {list} · printed p. {printed} · asset {asset} · applicability needs source verification

import.orphans: {count} callout numbers on the drawings have no matching parts row. Check them before relying on this catalog.
import.queueHelp: These rows were not published because they failed a check or sit on a figure that could not be classified with confidence. They are kept with the import record.
import.queueSaved: {count} review rows were saved to the persistent review queue.
import.notProvisioned: The persistent review queue is not installed yet, so only the first 500 of {count} queued rows are kept with the import record. An administrator must approve the pending catalog migration.
import.errNotPdf: Select an OEM parts catalog PDF.
import.errTooBig: This PDF is larger than the 100 MB catalog limit.
import.errBrand: Enter the OEM brand and model printed on the manual.
import.errSave: Could not save the OEM manual.
import.errNoRows: This PDF has no parts rows to save. Review the source pages first.

detail.title: Part details
detail.whereUsedNone: Not used in any other figure of this manual.
detail.evidenceNone: No drawing geometry is stored for this figure.
detail.missingCallouts: Table indexes not found on the drawing
detail.stockNote: OEM parts are not yet linked to internal stock items, so no stock level or work-order status is shown. Add the part to the selection to raise it through Parts Requests.

status.verified: Matched to the parts table by index numbers
status.estimated: Partly matched, estimated from PDF text
status.ambiguous: Could not be matched with confidence

summary.ignored: {count} other numerals on the drawing ignored

coverage.title: Import coverage
coverage.pages: {parsed} of {pages} PDF pages read as parts lists
coverage.unparsed: {count} pages with a parts table that could not be read
coverage.queued: {count} rows waiting in the review queue
coverage.truncated: The saved queue is cut at 500 rows; the full queue needs the pending catalog migration.
coverage.figures: {matched} of {total} figures matched to their parts table
coverage.ambiguous: {count} figures could not be matched with confidence
coverage.accuracy: Accuracy is not measured for this manual: no reviewed sample exists.

review.title: Review queue
review.published: {count} approved parts published. Existing rows were not overwritten.
review.pickEmpty: Choose a queued record to see its evidence.
review.category: Standard category (saved as a rule for similar manuals)
review.ruleSaved: Category saved and will be reused on similar headings.
review.boundsSaved: Boundary saved. Re-imports will not replace it.
review.loadError: Could not load the review queue.
review.pdfError: Could not open the stored PDF for evidence.
review.notProvisioned: The persistent review queue and correction history need the pending catalog migration, which an administrator must approve. Until then only the first 500 queued rows are kept with each import record.

basket.sameNumber: Identical part number in the internal parts catalog; not a verified link
basket.clearBody: All selected parts are removed from this list. Parts already sent to Parts Requests are not affected.

tools.title: Figure tools
tools.help: Fix figure and table links by hand. Moved parts are marked as admin edited and are never overwritten by a re-import.
tools.noParts: No parts are linked to this figure.
tools.reassign: Move selected parts to another figure
tools.ratio: Cut position (% from left or top)
tools.noCrop: This figure has no stored boundary to split.

reprocess.title: Reprocess preview
reprocess.help: Re-reads the stored PDF and shows what would change. Nothing is written by this step.
reprocess.error: The preview could not be produced.
reprocess.protectedRecords: protected (admin corrected or used by a work order)
reprocess.missingNow: stored parts not found in the new run (kept)
reprocess.safe: Existing records and manual corrections are preserved. Only new parts can be sent to review.

manual.deleteBody: {name} and its stored PDF will be removed. Parts linked to work orders keep their request notes. This cannot be undone.
manual.deleteError: The manual could not be deleted.
